# Prabod Pubudu

> Software Engineer & AI Engineer specializing in full-stack development and AI/ML systems (RAG, LangChain).

## About
Software Engineer with a strong AI/ML focus. Builds full-stack applications and AI-powered systems,
including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines and LLM-integrated backends.

## Core Skills

- **Backend:** Node.js, NestJS, Express, Python, Django, Flask, FastAPI, Ruby, Go
- **Frontend:** React, Next.js, JavaScript, TypeScript
